note: Both sets capture the same core figure content (material legend, section markers, 70% span location), but Set A adds two genuine coordinate claims (NA x2 = -0.1 m, CG x2 = -0.15 m) that Set B omits. Set B instead pads its list with five redundant 'material layer' claims that merely repeat existing material entries plus a duplicate cross-section-location claim, adding trivial noise rather than information. Both sets share one weak claim whose quote ('Blade: IEA 15MW Offshore Reference Turbine; Section : 0.7') does not support the '70 % span' value. On balance A is the more informative and less padded set.
